check.prompt: What is a contract in this sense?
options: A legal document signed by the team
A promise about what a part accepts and returns
A comment at the top of a file
check.explanation: A contract states what a part takes in and what it gives back, so other code can rely on it.
check.hint: It is a promise about behaviour.

check.prompt: Why does the loop work for both Square and Rectangle?
options: They both keep the same promise: they have an area method
check.explanation: The loop only relies on area existing, and both shapes provide it. They do not even need a shared parent.
check.hint: What does the loop call on each shape?

check.prompt: What can you safely change inside Square?
options: How it works out the area, as long as area still returns the right number
The name of its area method
Whether area returns a number or a word
check.explanation: Callers depend only on the contract, so the inside is free to change while the promise holds.
